spans.s: द (1) the consonant द्, the vowel अ being added for facility of utter- ance or use; (2) a technical term used in the Jainendra Vyakarana for the term आत्मनेपद in the gram- mar of Panini.
दा tad. affix named 'vibhakti' app- lied to the words सर्व, एक, अन्य, किं, यत्,तत् and इदम् in the locative case; e.g. सर्वदा, एकदा, कदा: cf. Kas. on
